name: WhatsApp TUI
author: leonavas
description: WhatsApp in the Omarchy bar, through whatsapp-tui (the WhatsApp terminal client): a bar icon that opens it, parks it out of sight, badges unread direct chats and groups, previews them on hover, notifies new messages and pauses notifications.

barWidget.description: WhatsApp as a tray icon, through whatsapp-tui: click to show or hide the window, red and blue badges for unread direct chats and groups, a preview of them on hover, desktop notifications for new messages.

schema.label: Custom launch command
schema.description: Left empty, the widget runs `omarchy-launch-tui --app-id=<window class> whatsapp-tui`. Whatever you set here must open a window with the class below.

schema.label: Window class to watch
schema.description: Matched exactly (case-insensitive). Also the app id the default launch command gives the terminal. A class other than the default also needs WHATSAPP_TUI_WINDOW_CLASS set for whatsapp-tui.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Mono draws the white WhatsApp mark tinted with the bar's color. Outline draws it white with a faint dark edge, readable on light and dark bars. Color draws the green mark. Glyph draws any Nerd Font character instead.

schema.label: Glyph
schema.description: Only used by the Glyph style.

schema.label: Glyph size (px)
schema.description: 0 follows the bar's icon size. Only used by the Glyph style.

schema.label: Vertical nudge (px)
schema.description: Negative moves the glyph up, for glyphs whose ink sits off the bar's line.

schema.label: Unread badge
schema.description: Two badges at once: unread messages in direct chats at the bottom-right in red, in groups at the top-right in blue. Muted chats count in neither. A badge with nothing to count is not drawn. Dot marks the same corners without numbers.

schema.label: Badge layout
schema.description: Split shows direct chats (red, bottom-right) and groups (blue, top-right) as two badges. Combined shows one badge, bottom-right, with their sum: red while a direct chat waits, blue when only groups do. The icon's menu toggles this as "Group notifications".

schema.label: Direct chat badge color
schema.description: Unread messages in direct chats. Empty follows the theme's urgent color.

schema.label: Group badge color
schema.description: Unread messages in groups. Empty uses the direct chat color.

schema.label: Dot size
schema.description: The dot's diameter as a fraction of the icon. Only used by the Dot badge.

schema.label: Color the icon while something is waiting
schema.description: Mono and Glyph styles only: the mark takes the direct chat color, or the group color when only groups are waiting.

schema.label: What a click on the open window does
schema.description: Special workspace parks the window in a hidden Hyprland special workspace, where whatsapp-tui keeps running and counting.

schema.label: Name of the special workspace
schema.description: Used as special:<name>. "scratchpad" is Omarchy's own, toggled with SUPER+S.

schema.label: Open straight into the special workspace
schema.description: Every new whatsapp-tui window moves to special:<name>, and a click shows or hides that workspace. The icon's menu toggles this as "Open in Scratchpad".

schema.label: Open whatsapp-tui when the shell starts
schema.description: The icon's menu toggles this as "Launch on Login".

schema.label: Show and focus whatsapp-tui when it opens
schema.description: Off, whatsapp-tui opens in the background, hidden in the special workspace and without taking the focus, also when opened from the icon. The icon's menu toggles this as "Launch in Foreground".

schema.label: Dim the icon while whatsapp-tui is not running
Remove the icon from the bar while whatsapp-tui is not running
Messages shown per chat
schema.description: The newest unread messages of each chat, up to the 5 whatsapp-tui publishes.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: A notification for each new message, except in muted chats, while notifications are paused, and for the chat you have open on screen. A click opens the chat at that message. The icon's menu toggles this as "Desktop notifications".

schema.label: Show the message in notifications
schema.description: Off, notifications say who wrote but not what.

schema.label: While notifications are paused
schema.description: Bell fades the mark and puts a small bell-off in the bottom-right corner, Dim fades the whole icon, None shows nothing. A pause hides both badges.
